purpose: Keep candidate JavaScript, callbacks, object identity, and mutable unist nodes out of the trusted node:test process.

transport.cumulative_failure_mode: cache first fatal process failure so all frozen leaves complete

operations.inventory: Return bounded package metadata, exact export kinds and action values, and declaration-presence flags.
operations.walk: Construct allowlisted unist-util-is tests and visitor actions inside the candidate child, call visitParents, and return visit projections plus the mutated JSON tree.
operations.deep: Construct a bounded deep tree inside the child and return only visit count and maximum ancestor depth.
operations.error: Exercise missing arguments and a fixed throwing visitor, returning a bounded exception record.

forbidden_boundary_values: functions, symbols, BigInts, accessors, custom prototypes, cycles, and native objects
